financial_statements_and_notes.notes:
[chunk 3/3] 
SECTION COVERAGE: This section is primarily segment financials (revenue by geography, segment assets, PP&E, D&A). It does NOT contain named SPV/VIE disclosures, AI lab investments, or named third-party counterparty commitments. No Anthropic or other AI lab investment details are present here (those would appear in the investments footnote). Key signals extracted:

1. CAPEX_ROI_GAP (severity 3): AWS PP&E additions doubled YoY to $53.3B in 2024 with D&A growing only modestly ($12.5B→$13.3B), indicating a massive and rapidly growing asset base whose revenue ramp is unproven. Total consolidated capex hit $85.8B.

2. HIDDEN_LEVERAGE (severity 3): Combined U.S. PP&E + operating leases reached $241.6B (+23% YoY), non-U.S. adds $87.2B, for a $328.8B total obligation footprint. Operating leases are on-balance-sheet post-ASC 842 but the scale and growth rate create meaningful refinancing/renewal risk not captured in headline net income.

3. Finance leases and build-to-suit arrangements noted for both North America and AWS segments — these are on-balance-sheet but reflect structural commitments to landlords/developers.

No investments, named counterparties for capex, or SPV structures are disclosed in this specific excerpt. This analyst recommends cross-referencing with AMZN's Note on "Other Long-Term Liabilities," "Lease Obligations," and "Equity Method Investments" (including Anthropic stake) from other sections of the same 10-K for a complete picture.
